title: He Kicked Me Out Like Trash
description: Thrown out by her own family, Janet Jones rebuilds her life on her own terms until a billionaire CEO proposes to her in front of everyone who doubted her. A roughly 106-minute YouTube upload with over 4.4 million views since its July 2026 release.

audienceReactions.quote: Who else read comments before watching
audienceReactions.author: @winsomefoster

audienceReactions.quote: How many men out there fell into a marriage after believing their side chick was carrying their baby but still haven't found out they were tricked by someone else's baby?
audienceReactions.author: @8Bonjour

audienceReactions.quote: Why would you leave your baby when you already know how horrible those people are?? So ridiculous!
